description: Cryptographically erase one memory by its cell id (GDPR Art. 17). Destroying the wrapped key leaves the content unreadable to everyone, the operator included. Irreversible: use it when erasure is the intent, not to tidy a working set. With warmStart "delete", it instead destroys one encrypted warm-start snapshot, its key first.

id.description: Memory cell id (hex) to erase. Required unless warmStart is "delete".

snapshotId.description: With warmStart "delete": the snapshot to destroy. Blank otherwise.

token.description: With warmStart: 16 to 32 characters from a-z and 0-9, chosen at random for this call. Blank otherwise.

warmStart.description: "delete" destroys the snapshot named by snapshotId instead of a memory. Only snapshotId and token go with it. Leave it blank to erase a memory by id.

name: saihm_forget
title: Forget (GDPR erasure)
